title: The 950 Station Anthem
style: folk punk acoustiCaparezza-style Italian alternative rap, live drums, lo-fi industrial synth bass, post-punk, spoken word, dry wit, anti-commercial, male and female vocals alternating, mid-tempo birthday anthem
lyrics:
(Verse 1)
The page layout copies, the clipboard is full,
Pasting the lines of the network control.
A history printed, a log of the race,
Between the web servers and VPN space.
Nine hundred and fifty production-grade domains,
Running through proxies to handle the strains.
You’re building a network for a thousand to come,
Beating the hardware like a corporate drum.
(Chorus)
Dah data, dah data, it fills up the logs,
Moving the routing right out of the bogs.
Keep the web traffic and mesh grids apart,
To protect the main engine before the surges start.
Sing it back like a song, pal, clear and out loud,
950 stations secure in the cloud.
(Verse 2)
The orange cloud covers the marketing site,
Absorbing the traffic and keeping it light.
But the VPN tunnel demands a straight path,
Bypassing the firewall to avoid system wrath.
So switch to the grey cloud and open the gate,
Let the production database calculate.
No standard SQLite can carry this load,
Deploy the Postgres to handle the road.
(Chorus)
Dah data, dah data, it fills up the logs,
Moving the routing right out of the bogs.
Keep the web traffic and mesh grids apart,
To protect the main engine before the surges start.
Sing it back like a song, pal, clear and out loud,
950 stations secure in the cloud.
(Outro)
The past text is printed, the record is set,
A blueprint for scaling without any regret.
The file sockets open, the system runs wide,
Ready for the surge on the technical side.
Yeah, sing it back, pal, the settings are true,
The next line of data is waiting for you.
